cards.title: One Shared Top Bar
cards.text: Every dashboard opens with the same slim bar: Apps Home on the left, agent name in the middle, Share Status on the right. Same height and order everywhere.

cards.title: Title Before Report
cards.text: Put the dashboard title first and the Morning or Evening Report right under it. Today about half the dashboards show the report above the title, so you land without knowing where you are.

cards.title: Report As One Line That Expands
cards.text: Show the report as a single summary line, like Evening Report, 5 Updates, that opens on tap. The full text no longer pushes everything below the fold.

cards.title: Sticky Mini Header On Scroll
cards.text: After you scroll past the title, a thin bar sticks to the top with the agent name and Apps Home link. It hides again when you scroll up to the top.

cards.title: Urgent Count Pill In The Top Bar
cards.text: A small red pill such as 2 Urgent sits in the top bar and opens the collapsed urgent dropdown. Nothing urgent means no pill at all.

cards.title: Decisions Owed Right Under The Report
cards.text: Put the Decisions You Owe dropdown directly under the report on every dashboard, so the thing that needs you is always in the same spot.

cards.title: Same Section Order Everywhere
cards.text: Use one order on all dashboards: Report, Decisions, Apps, Open Items, Recent Work. You learn it once and know where to look on each one.

cards.title: Consistent Dashboard Names
cards.text: Name every page Agent Name Command Center. Today some say just Legal, Portfolio, Miles Agent or Command Center, which reads unevenly in the tab and the top bar.

cards.title: Featured Deck Slot Below The Report
cards.text: Give new decks one fixed Featured slot right under the report instead of stacking big hero cards above the title.

cards.title: Condensed Rows That Expand
cards.text: Turn Open Items and Recent Work into one-line rows with a small chevron. Tap a row to see the detail, tap again to close.

cards.title: Show Five Then See All
cards.text: Show the five newest Recent Work rows and a See All row that expands the rest. Long histories stop dominating the page.

cards.title: Status Dot On Each Row
cards.text: A small colored dot at the start of each row shows Done, In Progress or Waiting. Color stays a micro-dose, never full colored rows.

cards.title: Right-Aligned Dates In Rows
cards.text: Put dates in a narrow right column in grey so titles line up on the left and the eye can scan straight down.

cards.title: Two-Line Card Limit
cards.text: Cap card descriptions at two lines with a fade, and show the rest on expand. Cards stay even height in the grid.

cards.title: Tighter Vertical Rhythm
cards.text: Use one spacing scale (8, 16, 24, 32) for gaps between rows, cards and sections. It removes the uneven gaps seen between sections today.

cards.title: Counts In Section Headers
cards.text: Put the number of items next to each section header, for example Open Items 7, so you know the size before expanding.

cards.title: Stat Tiles As One Strip
cards.text: Put headline numbers in one even strip of small tiles under the title, all the same height, instead of loose numbers scattered in cards.

cards.title: A To Z Apps List
cards.text: List each dashboard's apps A to Z by default, with a small sort switch for A to Z, Newest and Most Used.

cards.title: Sort Control On Long Lists
cards.text: Any list over ten rows gets a small Sort dropdown in its header: Newest, Oldest, A to Z, Priority.

cards.title: Filter Chips Above Lists
cards.text: Small outline chips such as All, Waiting, Done filter a list in place without leaving the page.

cards.title: Priority Groups Collapse By Default
cards.text: Group Open Items into P0, P1, P2 dropdowns, with P0 open and the rest closed with counts.

cards.title: Apps As A Carousel
cards.text: Show each agent's apps as a swipeable carousel of cards with arrows and dots, instead of a long stacked list on the phone.

cards.title: Recent Work Carousel On Phone
cards.text: On the phone, show Recent Work as a sideways carousel of small cards so the page stays short.

cards.title: Carousel Arrows At 44 Pixels
cards.text: Make carousel arrows and dots at least 44 pixels to tap, with the dots inside a larger hit area.

cards.title: Peek The Next Card
cards.text: Let the next carousel card peek in at the right edge so it is obvious you can swipe.

cards.title: Grid On Desktop, Carousel On Phone
cards.text: The same cards become a carousel on the phone and a plain grid at 1470 and up, so nothing is hidden on big screens.

cards.title: One Type Scale For All Dashboards
cards.text: Use one shared scale for title, section header, row title and body text. Today the title ranges from 28 to 104 pixels across dashboards.

cards.title: Scale Text Up On Big Screens
cards.text: Raise body text to about 20 pixels at 2560 wide. Several dashboards keep 16 pixel text on a 2560 screen, which is hard to read from a distance.

cards.title: Smaller Hero Title On Phone
cards.text: Keep the phone title around 32 pixels so it fits on one or two lines and leaves room for the report.

cards.title: Short Uppercase Labels Only
cards.text: Use small uppercase Khand labels only for short tags like Ready or Waiting, never for sentences.

cards.title: Readable Line Length
cards.text: Cap paragraphs at about 70 characters wide, even when the page is wide, so long text stays easy to read.

cards.title: Content Width Cap Or Real Grid
cards.text: At 2560, either cap content at about 1600 pixels or switch to a three or four column grid. Several pages stretch rows across the full 2560.

cards.title: Two Column Desktop Layout
cards.text: At 1470, put Report and Decisions on the left and Apps and Open Items on the right, so the page is one screen tall.

cards.title: Side Rail Navigation On Wide Screens
cards.text: On screens 1470 and wider, show a thin left rail with section links that highlights as you scroll.

cards.title: Bigger Cards On Large Monitors
cards.text: At 2560, grow card padding and icon size with the text so cards do not look like tiny tiles on a big monitor.

cards.title: Visible Focus Rings For Arrow Keys
cards.text: Show a clear focus ring on every card and row so the dashboard works from a keyboard or TV remote.

cards.title: Shorter Phone Pages
cards.text: Target under about four phone screens of scrolling by collapsing long sections. Some dashboards run past ten screens today.

cards.title: Thumb-Reach Main Actions
cards.text: Put the main action for a card at the bottom right of the card on the phone, where the thumb lands.

cards.title: Full-Width Rows On Phone
cards.text: On the phone, rows run edge to edge with a hairline divider instead of boxed cards, saving side padding.

cards.title: Add To Home Screen Everywhere
cards.text: Give every dashboard the small Add To Home Screen button WellNest has, placed in the top bar next to Apps Home.

cards.title: No Inline Paragraph Walls On Phone
cards.text: Any text block over four lines on the phone becomes a collapsed row with a one-line summary.

cards.title: Small Drawn Line Icons
cards.text: Give each section and app a small drawn line icon in one stroke weight, and no emoji anywhere.

cards.title: One Accent Per Dashboard
cards.text: Each agent gets one accent color used only for its pill, active tab and link underline. The rest stays black, white and grey.

cards.title: Subtle Hover Lift
cards.text: Cards and rows lift one pixel with a soft shadow on hover, and no motion on touch screens.

cards.title: Accent Bar On Urgent Rows Only
cards.text: Use a thin left color bar only on urgent or waiting rows, so color always means something.

cards.title: Warm Light Background Everywhere
cards.text: Use the same warm white page background and pure white cards on every dashboard so they feel like one family.

cards.title: Apps Home Always Top Left
cards.text: The Apps Home link sits in the same top-left spot on every dashboard, 44 pixels tall, same tab.

cards.title: Jump Links Under The Title
cards.text: A short row of jump links (Decisions, Apps, Open, Recent) under the title takes you straight to each section.

cards.title: Back To Top Button
cards.text: After two screens of scrolling, a small Back To Top button appears above the Share row.

cards.title: Share Just Above The Footer
cards.text: Share always sits in page flow right above the footer, never in the top bar or a fixed bar.

cards.title: Footer Link Tap Area
cards.text: Give the Built By Max Weberman link a 44 pixel tall tap area while keeping the text small and quiet.

cards.title: Apps Home Agent Rows A To Z
cards.text: Sort the agents inside Work, Personal and AI Resources A to Z, with an option to sort by most recent update.

cards.title: Apps Home Big Screen Grid
cards.text: At 2560 the three columns stay small with 16 pixel text. Scale tiles and text up so it reads from across the room.

cards.title: Apps Home Last Updated Dots
cards.text: Add a small status dot to each agent row showing whether its report is fresh today.

cards.title: Apps Home Footer Tap Target
cards.text: The footer Max Weberman link measured under 44 pixels tall. Add padding around it.

cards.title: Grok Bot Evening Report Collapse
cards.text: The Evening Report fills most of the first screen as a long bulleted block. Collapse it to one line with a count.

cards.title: Grok Bot Team Feed As Rows
cards.text: Show the Team Feed panel as condensed rows with agent name and time, expanding on tap, instead of text paragraphs.

cards.title: Grok Bot Apps Home Link Top Left
cards.text: The Apps Home link is not in the top area on Grok Bot. Add it top left like every other dashboard.

cards.title: Blog Drafts As A Carousel
cards.text: Fourteen drafts sit in stacked cards on the phone. Show them as a carousel with title, status and one Open button.

cards.title: Blog Article Text Off The Dashboard
cards.text: Full article sections (contracts, depreciation and more) render on the dashboard. Link to each draft instead so the page gets much shorter.

cards.title: Blog Width Cap At 2560
cards.text: The Blog page stretches to the full 2560 width. Cap it or move drafts into a four-column grid.

cards.title: Blog Sort Drafts
cards.text: Add a sort on the drafts list: Ready First, Newest, A to Z.

cards.title: Blueprint Title Above The Update Banner
cards.text: Blueprint opens with an 8 Updates banner before the house title. Move the title to the top and collapse the updates under it.

cards.title: Blueprint 3D Hero Smaller On Desktop
cards.text: The 3D model hero takes most of the 1470 screen. Shrink it to half width with the update list beside it.

cards.title: Branding Chip Tap Targets
cards.text: About 19 controls (filter checkboxes and Share) measured under 44 pixels on the phone. Enlarge the chips.

cards.title: Branding Deck List Condensed
cards.text: The page is about 10,000 pixels tall on the phone. Turn the 22 decks being built into condensed rows that expand.

cards.title: Branding Accent Swatches Carousel
cards.text: Show Accent Colors and Brand Files as carousels so they stop adding long scroll.

cards.title: Coach Questionnaire Collapsed
cards.text: The Top Coaching Suggestions questionnaire fills the first screens. Show it as one Featured card that opens the questions.

cards.title: Coach Title Scales At 1470
cards.text: The Coach title stays the same size at 1470 as on the phone. Step it up with the shared type scale.

cards.title: Coach Routines As A Compact Table
cards.text: Routines are four cards. Show them as one compact list of name and time, aligned in two columns.

cards.title: Construction Title Before Ready For You
cards.text: Ready For You and Hidden Valley text sit above the title. Move the title up and collapse the ready items.

cards.title: Construction Needs You Tap Target
cards.text: The Needs You control measured under 44 pixels. Give it a full-height tap area.

cards.title: Construction Stat Strip Scales Up
cards.text: The 25, 2 of 2 and Nov 5 stat strip and title stay the same size at 2560. Scale them up.

cards.title: Dump Priority Pills As Filters
cards.text: The 21 Open, P0 and P1 pills could filter the list on tap, turning them into real controls.

cards.title: Dump Thin Columns At 2560
cards.text: At 2560 the three Dump columns are thin and the page is short. Use wider cards and larger text.

cards.title: Japan Cottage Apps Home Link First
cards.text: Apps Home sits under the title block. Move it to the top-left spot.

cards.title: Japan Cottage Big Screen Scale
cards.text: At 2560 the title stays 34 pixels and body 16 pixels across the full width. Apply the big-screen scale and a width cap.

cards.title: Japan Cottage Two Apps Side By Side
cards.text: Show the two Japan apps as two equal cards side by side on desktop instead of a narrow left list.

cards.title: Jokes Title Above Fresh Start
cards.text: The Jokes title appears below the report and the ideas carousel. Put the title first.

cards.title: Jokes Bits As Expanding Rows
cards.text: Show Bits In Progress as one-line rows that expand to the full bit, instead of open cards.

cards.title: Legal Matters As Condensed Rows
cards.text: Open Legal Matters show full paragraphs. Use one-line rows with status and next date that expand.

cards.title: Legal Report Collapsed
cards.text: The Evening Report bullets sit open above the matters. Collapse it to one summary line.

cards.title: Portfolio Dashboards As Carousel
cards.text: Show the Portfolio sub-dashboards (Live, Speeding and more) as a carousel with a small line chart icon each.

cards.title: Portfolio Watch Item Pill
cards.text: Move the 1 Watch Item into the top bar as a pill that opens a collapsed dropdown.

cards.title: Prop Page Title
cards.text: Prop has no main title on the page. Add Prop Command Center above the property switcher.

cards.title: Prop Property Switcher Stays
cards.text: The Mellow Wood and Wickfield switcher works well. Keep it and reuse the same pattern on other multi-project dashboards.

cards.title: Prop Decision Rows Expand
cards.text: Decisions Max Owes are full sentences. Make them one line with an expand for the detail.

cards.title: Research Carousel Dots Tap Size
cards.text: On desktop about 11 carousel dots and controls measured under 44 pixels. Enlarge their hit area.

cards.title: Research Title Above The Deck
cards.text: The Next Steps deck sits above the Research title. Move it to the Featured slot under the title.

cards.title: Scout Page Length On Phone
cards.text: Scout is about 10,000 pixels tall on the phone. Collapse the 30-Day Plan, Peer Comparison and Takeaways into dropdowns.

cards.title: Scout Thumbnails As Carousel
cards.text: Show the 23 thumbnail images as one carousel rather than a long stack.

cards.title: Scout Channel Stats Strip
cards.text: Put Channel Stats into the shared stat strip right under the title.

cards.title: Thai Study App Rows Tap Size
cards.text: Five study app links measured under 44 pixels tall. Make each one a full-height row.

cards.title: UpKeep Full Page Title
cards.text: The title reads only Command Center. Use the full name so it matches the others.

cards.title: UpKeep Dropdowns Closed By Default
cards.text: Four of eight dropdowns start open. Start them closed with counts.

cards.title: UpKeep Video Version Chips
cards.text: The 30s and 45s chips measured under 44 pixels. Enlarge them.

cards.title: Video And Photo Share Placement
cards.text: Share sits in the top bar. Move it into page flow above the footer per the standard.

cards.title: Video And Photo Big Screen Text
cards.text: Body text stays 16 pixels at 2560. Apply the big-screen scale.

cards.title: WellNest One Featured Deck
cards.text: Two featured deck cards stack above the title. Merge them into one Featured slot under the title.

cards.title: WellNest Team Chat Collapsed
cards.text: Put Team Chat into a collapsed dropdown at the bottom so it does not compete with decisions.
